create_run.description: Start a run in an experiment, to log metrics and params to from a workflow.
create_run.name: create_run

parameters.description: The experiment. Pick one, or give its name, ID or link.
parameters.name: experiment

parameters.description: A name for the run. Leave blank for one MLflow makes up.
parameters.name: run_name

parameters.description: Tags to set, each a name and a value, such as team = fraud.

deleted.description: True when it is in MLflow's trash

duration_seconds.description: How long it ran, in seconds; empty while it runs

ended_at.description: When it ended (ISO 8601, UTC); blank while it runs
